name: Ageas
note: Belgium's largest insurer, listed on Euronext Brussels. Sole owner of AG Insurance since completing the buy-out of BNP Paribas Fortis's 25% stake in 2026 for €1.9 billion (announced 8 Dec 2025, completed May 2026). BNP Paribas Cardif simultaneously raised its stake in Ageas to 22.5%, with BNP Paribas nominating one non-executive director; a relationship agreement caps BNP Paribas at 25% minus one share (Ageas press release via newsroom.ag.be; Reinsurance News, 2026-05-01).
